shortDescription: Review delivery claims against a frozen handoff promise, attested evidence, two-party challenges and independent semantic consensus.
detailedDescription: ParcelCourt supports a delivery-claim lifecycle from consent and frozen promise through evidence submission, a distinct attestor, semantic adjudication, two-party challenges, second-round deliberation and finalization. The production app reads paged canonical case records and hash-linked history from Studionet, and provides wallet-validated signing and post-transaction receipt/state reconciliation.
problemSolved: Delivery disputes depend on natural-language handoff promises and evidence that may be incomplete, manipulated or contradictory.
whyThisRequiresGenLayer: Validators independently assess whether delivery evidence substantiates the exact frozen handoff promise and named recipient. Deterministic code alone cannot determine those semantic facts.
genuineSemanticConsensus: Leader and validators independently classify handoff_matches_promise, authorized_recipient_supported and evidence_sufficient. The strict vector and bounded deterministic verdict are validated; the second round incorporates both parties' challenge text; disagreement cannot become approval or alter parameters, actors, deadlines or rules.

browserQualification.registryVerification: PASS on the production alias on 2026-10-19: exact-ID search, canonical FINALIZED detail, challenge count, history entries and SHA-256 links verified.

securityAndQualificationSummary: Automated adversarial, state-machine, schema, address-compatibility, history-integrity and wallet E2E checks passed. A genuine Chromium signed transaction was reconciled against successful GenVM execution and canonical state. The synthetic full lifecycle finalized UNRESOLVED after both parties challenged. Production registry search/detail on deployment dpl_BQzpZhv1YEKyRrnshfNFQ6CqKXJm verified the canonical terminal state, two challenges and two hash-linked history entries; latest browser-wallet and registry checks passed.
reviewerInstructions: Open https://parcelcourt-genlayer.vercel.app and connect a wallet on Studionet chain 61999. Review contracts/parcelcourt.py, evidence/signed-browser-lifecycle.json, evidence/signed-browser-lifecycle-readback.json, evidence/browser-wallet-e2e.json, evidence/signed-browser-registry.json, and evidence/production-registry-retries.json. The BROWSER-LIFECYCLE-1792362304421-ParcelCourt case finalized UNRESOLVED; its scenario is synthetic and is not proof of a real delivery. Historical case GLV4-parcelcourt-39138804500 also finalized UNRESOLVED.
knownLimitationsAndExternalTrustAssumpti: Qualification cases and delivery evidence are synthetic. An attestor signature proves control of the agreed wallet, not carrier identity, physical delivery, or document authenticity. There is no carrier identity oracle, insurance escrow, or settlement. Studionet RPC can be intermittently unavailable or rate-limited; an initial production read failure and successful retry are recorded in evidence/production-registry-retries.json. Cases are append-only and not pruned.
